rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The provisional verbatim record of the Security Council's 3379th meeting (New York, 25 May 1994) records that Mr. Thabo Mbeki, First Executive Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa, was escorted to a place at the Council table, and the Council President then invites 'the First Executive Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa, His Excellency Mr. Thabo Mbeki' to speak as the first speaker.
